es_01.m_zh: 温暖、讲故事的开头，不着急，带一点神秘；说国王名字前停一下
es_01.d_zh: 画面：睡前，你翻开一本大图画书的第一页，上面是一座金色的王宫。孩子靠在你身边，等你开口。
es_01.m_en: warm storyteller opening, unhurried, a little mysterious; small pause before the name
es_01.d_en: Picture: bedtime. You open a big picture book at page one and see a golden palace. A child leans on you and waits.

es_02.m_zh: 温柔、带着微笑；说到“以斯帖”时慢下来
es_02.d_zh: 画面：你用手指着书上那个走进亮光里的女孩，她的王冠一闪一闪。你像介绍一位好朋友那样说出她的名字。
es_02.m_en: tender, smiling; slow down on her name
es_02.d_en: Picture: you point at the girl in the book who walks into the light. Her crown sparkles. You say her name like you introduce a good friend.

es_03a.m_zh: 又响又长，像典礼上的传令，有点摆架子
es_03a.d_zh: 画面：你站在王宫大门口，双手拢在嘴边，朝着长长的走廊喊，要让最远的人也听见。
es_03a.m_en: loud and long, ceremonial, a little pompous
es_03a.d_en: Picture: you stand at the palace door with your hands around your mouth. You call down a long hall so the farthest person can hear.

es_03b.m_zh: 很多人一起说，低着头，有点不情愿
es_03b.d_zh: 画面：你和一群人挤在路边，哈曼走过来，大家只好弯下腰。你心里其实不太想拜他。
es_03b.m_en: many voices together, bowing, a little reluctant
es_03b.d_en: Picture: you stand in a crowd by the road. Haman walks past and everyone has to bow. Inside, you do not really want to.

es_03.m_zh: 得意洋洋、鼻子朝天，每个字都慢慢品；最后捧腹大笑，笑得有点太久
es_03.d_zh: 画面：你挺着大肚子走在红地毯上，两边的人都弯着腰。你转头对着观众炫耀，像刚得了第一名的小孩。
es_03.m_en: hugely pleased with himself, nose in the air, enjoying every word; a big belly laugh at the end that goes on too long
es_03.d_en: Picture: you walk on a red carpet with your tummy out. People bow on both sides. You turn to the audience and show off, like a child who just won first prize.

es_04.m_zh: 平静、带一点好笑；说末底改的话之前停一下
es_04.d_zh: 画面：你指着图画里唯一站得笔直的那个人，其他人都弯着腰。你对孩子眨眨眼：看，就他不拜。
es_04.m_en: calm, a little amused; small pause before Mordecai's words
es_04.d_en: Picture: you point at the one man in the picture who stands straight. Everyone else bows. You wink at the child: look, only he will not bow.

es_04b.m_zh: 突然爆发，又尖又气、话都说不利索；三声“哼”一声比一声大，好笑不吓人
es_04b.d_zh: 画面：你刚发现有人不拜你，脸涨得通红，像抢不到玩具的小孩。每说一声“哼”，你就跺一下脚。
es_04b.m_en: explodes: shrill, spluttering, a tantrum; three stamping 'hmph's, each louder; funny, not scary
es_04b.d_en: Picture: you just saw that one man will not bow to you. Your face goes red, like a child who lost a toy. You stamp your foot on every 'hmph'.

es_05.m_zh: 狡猾的小声、慢、油腻、对王甜得发腻；两处偷偷的停顿
es_05.d_zh: 画面：你踮着脚溜到王座旁边，弯腰凑到王的耳边，一边说一边偷看四周有没有人听见。
es_05.m_en: sly half-whisper, slow, oily, sugar-sweet to the king; two sneaky pauses
es_05.d_en: Picture: you tiptoe up to the throne and bend close to the king's ear. While you talk, you look around to check that nobody is listening.

es_06.m_zh: 低沉、随随便便、有点无聊；先“嗯”地想一下
es_06.d_zh: 画面：你歪在王座上，用手撑着头，都快睡着了。你懒得多想，摘下戒指随手一递。
es_06.m_en: deep, careless, a little bored; a thinking 'hmm' first
es_06.d_en: Picture: you sit low in your throne with your head on your hand, almost asleep. You do not want to think. You pull off your ring and hand it over.

es_06b.m_zh: 转向观众，搓着手；先坏坏地偷笑，然后得意
es_06b.d_zh: 画面：你背对着王，把戒指举到眼前看，它闪着金光。你搓搓手，悄悄把秘密告诉观众。
es_06b.m_en: turns to the audience, rubbing his hands; a wicked little giggle, then gleeful
es_06b.d_en: Picture: your back is to the king. You hold the ring up and it shines gold. You rub your hands and tell the audience your secret.

es_07.m_zh: 年长的男人，着急但充满爱，像从远处传话；最后一句放慢
es_07.d_zh: 画面：你站在王宫门外，隔着高高的墙朝里面的以斯帖喊话。说到最后一句，你想让她把每个字都记在心里。
es_07.m_en: older man, urgent but loving, calling from a distance; slower on the last sentence
es_07.d_en: Picture: you stand outside the palace gate and call over a high wall to Esther inside. On the last sentence, you want her to keep every word in her heart.

es_08.m_zh: 害怕、小声、犹豫；说“可是”之前吸一口气
es_08.d_zh: 画面：你一个人站在房间里，望着通往王座的那扇大门，手紧紧抓着衣角。你声音很小，像在对自己说。
es_08.m_en: scared, quiet, hesitant; a breath before 'but'
es_08.d_en: Picture: you stand alone in your room and look at the big door to the throne room. Your hands hold your dress tight. You speak softly, almost to yourself.

es_09.m_zh: 先深吸一口气，然后稳稳的、勇敢；越说越坚定，最后几个字最有力
es_09.d_zh: 画面：你刚跪着祷告完，慢慢站起来，抬起下巴。你看着朋友们的眼睛，已经下定了决心。
es_09.m_en: a deep breath, then steady and brave; getting stronger, strongest on the last words
es_09.d_en: Picture: you just prayed on your knees. Now you stand up slowly and lift your chin. You look into your friends' eyes. You have decided.

es_10.m_zh: 压低声音、紧张、很慢；让问句悬在空中
es_10.d_zh: 画面：你屏住呼吸，看着以斯帖踩上一级又一级台阶，鼓声咚、咚、咚。你凑近孩子，小声问出那个问题。
es_10.m_en: hushed, suspenseful, slow; let the question hang
es_10.d_en: Picture: you hold your breath and watch Esther climb one step, then the next. A drum goes boom, boom. You lean close to the child and whisper the question.

es_11.m_zh: 先惊喜，然后温暖大方；声音里带着笑
es_11.d_zh: 画面：你坐在王座上一抬头，看见最爱的王后站在门口。你高兴地伸出金杖，像看到好朋友来家里玩。
es_11.m_en: surprised, then warm and generous; a smile in the voice
es_11.d_en: Picture: you sit on your throne and look up. Your dear queen is at the door. You hold out your golden sceptre, as happy as when a friend comes to visit.

es_12.m_zh: 有礼貌、甜甜的、带一点小聪明；轻快
es_12.d_zh: 画面：你刚摸到金杖的尖，知道自己安全了。你微微行礼，心里藏着一个小计划，像邀请人来参加惊喜派对。
es_12.m_en: polite, sweet, a little clever; light
es_12.d_en: Picture: you just touched the tip of the golden sceptre, so you are safe. You bow a little. You have a small plan in your heart, like an invitation to a surprise party.

es_12b.m_zh: 乐得直蹦，几乎像在唱歌；“和我”之前停一下，然后开心大笑
es_12b.d_zh: 画面：你一蹦一跳地走在回家的路上，手里像捏着一张请帖。你拍着胸口，对着镜子里的自己夸个不停。
es_12b.m_en: giddy, bouncing, almost singing; pause before 'and me', then a delighted laugh
es_12b.d_en: Picture: you skip and hop on the way home, as if you hold an invitation card. You pat your chest and praise yourself in the mirror.

es_12c.m_zh: 若有所思、和气、慢；是真心在问
es_12c.d_zh: 画面：你坐在王座上摸着胡子，想起有个好人救过你，却还没谢他。你转头认真地问身边的大官。
es_12c.m_en: thoughtful, kind, slow; a real question
es_12c.d_en: Picture: you sit on the throne and touch your beard. You remember a good man who once saved you, and you never thanked him. You turn and ask your helper.

es_12d.m_zh: 用手挡着嘴，对观众说悄悄话；得意、美滋滋
es_12d.d_zh: 画面：你侧过身，把手挡在嘴边，不让王听见。你朝观众挤挤眼睛，觉得答案太明显了。
es_12d.m_en: a stage whisper to the audience behind his hand; smug, delighted
es_12d.d_en: Picture: you turn to the side and put a hand by your mouth so the king cannot hear. You wink at the audience. The answer is so easy!

es_12e.m_zh: 气派、做着美梦、越说越大；最后一句像传令官那样骄傲地喊出来
es_12e.d_zh: 画面：你闭上眼睛，看见自己穿着王袍骑在高高的大马上，满街的人都在看你。你越想越美，手也跟着比划起来。
es_12e.m_en: grand, dreamy, carried away, bigger and bigger; the last phrase shouted proudly like a herald
es_12e.d_en: Picture: you close your eyes and see yourself in the king's robe on a tall horse. The whole street looks at you. The dream grows and your arms start to wave.

es_12f.m_zh: 满意、温暖、干脆；带着笑，名字说得清楚简单
es_12f.d_zh: 画面：你一拍王座的扶手，觉得这主意棒极了。你笑着指向门外，马上把这件事交给哈曼去办。
es_12f.m_en: pleased, warm, brisk; a smile; the name clear and simple
es_12f.d_en: Picture: you slap the arm of your throne. What a great idea! You smile, point to the door and give Haman the job right away.

es_12g.m_zh: 不敢相信：噎住、结巴，最后挤出一声尖叫
es_12g.d_zh: 画面：你的美梦像气球一样“啪”地破了。你张着嘴，手指发抖，那个名字卡在喉咙里说不出来。
es_12g.m_en: cannot believe it: choking, stammering, then a strangled squeak on the name
es_12g.d_en: Picture: your happy dream pops like a balloon. Your mouth hangs open and your finger shakes. The name gets stuck in your throat.

es_12h.m_zh: 憋着笑，讲故事的人很享受这个大反转
es_12h.d_zh: 画面：你看着图画里垂头丧气牵着马的哈曼，快要笑出声了。你用手捂着嘴，把这件好笑的事讲给孩子听。
es_12h.m_en: trying not to laugh; a storyteller enjoying the twist
es_12h.d_en: Picture: in the book, Haman pulls the horse with his head down. You almost laugh out loud. You cover your mouth and tell the child this funny part.

es_12i.m_zh: 咬着牙、闷闷不乐、平平的、很不情愿；最后的“哼”越来越小
es_12i.d_zh: 画面：你拖着脚走在大街上，手里牵着马，马上坐着你最讨厌的人。大家都在看，你只好一个字一个字挤出来。
es_12i.m_en: through gritted teeth, sulky, flat; a 'hmph' that dies away
es_12i.d_en: Picture: you drag your feet down the street and pull a horse. On the horse sits the man you like least. Everyone is looking, so you push the words out one by one.

es_13.m_zh: 发抖但勇敢；说到“我的族人”时声音哽一下
es_13.d_zh: 画面：宴席上烛光暖暖的，你放下杯子，在王面前跪下来。你的手有点抖，但你抬头看着王的眼睛。
es_13.m_en: trembling but brave; the voice catches on 'my people'
es_13.d_en: Picture: the banquet is warm with candle light. You put down your cup and kneel before the king. Your hands shake a little, but you look up into his eyes.

es_14.m_zh: 震惊又生气，声音大但不是吼；一句一句短而有力
es_14.d_zh: 画面：你“腾”地从椅子上站起来，杯子都碰倒了。居然有人要伤害你最爱的王后，你一定要问清楚。
es_14.m_en: shocked and angry, loud but not shouting; short sharp phrases
es_14.d_en: Picture: you jump up from your chair and knock over your cup. Someone wants to hurt your dear queen! You must find out who.

es_15.m_zh: 清楚、坚定；说“哈曼”之前鼓一下勇气
es_15.d_zh: 画面：你站起来，伸直手臂，手指越过桌子指向正在偷吃的哈曼。全屋的人都安静下来，看着你的手指。
es_15.m_en: clear and firm; a beat of courage before 'Haman'
es_15.d_en: Picture: you stand up and stretch out your arm. Your finger points across the table at Haman, who is busy eating. The whole room goes quiet.

es_16.m_zh: 哭哭啼啼、尖声慌张、又快又喘，快哭出来了；要好笑
es_16.d_zh: 画面：你吓得跳起来，帽子都飞了，“扑通”一声跪在地上。你一会儿朝王后爬，一会儿朝王爬，两只手不停地拜。
es_16.m_en: blubbering, squeaky panic, fast and breathless, close to tears; funny
es_16.d_en: Picture: you jump with fright and your hat flies off. You drop to your knees. You crawl to the queen, then to the king, with your hands together.

es_16b.m_zh: 王的命令：响亮、低沉、一锤定音；不是尖叫
es_16b.d_zh: 画面：你站得笔直，手臂一挥指向大门。门口的卫兵一听见你的声音，就立刻跑过来。
es_16b.m_en: a royal command: loud, deep and final; not a scream
es_16b.d_en: Picture: you stand very straight and swing your arm toward the door. The guards at the door hear your voice and come running.

es_16c.m_zh: 被拖走时又哭又踢：长长的“不要啊”，然后不服气，最后大哭着越来越远
es_16c.d_zh: 画面：两个卫兵架着你的胳膊往外拖，你的脚在地上乱蹬。门越来越远，你的声音也越来越小，像被拖出游乐场的小孩。
es_16c.m_en: wailing and kicking as he is dragged off: a long howling 'no', then outraged, then a big wail that fades away
es_16c.d_en: Picture: two guards hold your arms and pull you out. Your feet kick the floor. The door gets farther away and your voice gets smaller, like a child carried out of a playground.

es_17.m_zh: 先松一口气，然后明亮欢喜；说到开心的地方快一点
es_17.d_zh: 画面：你翻到新的一页，阳光一下子照进来，彩纸满天飞，大家手拉手转圈。你长长地舒了一口气，然后笑起来。
es_17.m_en: relief, then bright joy; a little faster on the happy part
es_17.d_en: Picture: you turn to a new page. Sunlight comes in, confetti flies and people dance in a ring. You let out a long breath, and then you smile.

es_18.m_zh: 温暖的道理，直接对孩子说；说“你也可以哦”时带着笑
es_18.d_zh: 画面：故事讲完了，你合上书，转过脸看着孩子的眼睛。你轻轻碰一下他的鼻尖，把最后一句送给他。
es_18.m_en: warm moral, speaking right to the child; smile on 'You can too'
es_18.d_en: Picture: the story is over. You close the book and look into the child's eyes. You touch the child's nose gently and give the last words as a gift.
